overview: ChainStock is a fully onchain stock watchlist and price alert app powered by the Internet Computer, with live Finnhub data, TradingView charts, and Internet Identity authentication.
features: Internet Identity sign-in — no passwords, no accounts
Personal watchlist with live prices, change %, and market cap
Price alerts with automatic 5-minute checking and triggered notifications
TradingView charts and widgets on stock detail pages
Command palette search with debounced Finnhub results
Market heatmap and news feed on the dashboard
Optional onboarding flow with Skip for now on every step
Triggered alert toasts on app load — auto-dismiss after 6 seconds
Full dark theme with teal accent color
